notes: Manufacturer spec page confirms a single USB 2.0 Video Class (UVC) interface as the device's only physical I/O; the device is bus-powered via this same USB connection, so there is no separate power connector. The cable is captive/attached to the document camera and terminates in a USB Type-A plug for the host computer (Mac/PC/Chromebook). This base V4K model has no HDMI output — that is a distinguishing feature of the separate IPEVO VZ-R / V4K PRO models, so do not confuse them. Cross-checked against global.ipevo.com/products/v4k/specs (same "USB 2.0 Video Class (UVC) interface" wording) and B&H's listing summary ("USB Type-A Output"), both consistent with the primary source.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Attached/captive USB cable (~4.9 ft / 150cm) terminating in USB Type-A; device is bus-powered over this connection, no separate power input
